//: P1-C05: host keyboard players. Each cluster is a two-stick player (DRIVE + ACTION) with its own Identify and READY keys (owner, 2026-10-03); holding Identify + READY for leaveHoldMs leaves the seat. KeyboardEvent.code values, so layouts don't matter. Host commands (the bug-clip chord Ctrl/⌘+Shift+B, host UI) never use a cluster key: cluster keys are ignored while Ctrl, ⌘ or Alt is down.

reserved.//: Keys no cluster may use (checked by web/host/tests/clusters.test.mjs). bugClip: the clip chord's key (plan §13b.6), reserved outright so a held cluster never half-presses it. hostUi: focus, activate, back, the browser's function keys and the dev drawer.
